experimental_method: Static gas absorption: degassed water or NaCl solution in a glass cell, gas admitted from a calibrated flask, solubility from PVT balance of the gas introduced, at low pressure (<0.1 MPa); NaCl content checked by evaporation to dryness after the run.
uncertainties_stated: Instrument table (Table 2) lists sensitivity/uncertainty of T (0.001/0.1 K), absolute pressure (0.1/1.7 mbar), differential pressure, balance; no uncertainty on x1 or H stated.
quality_remarks: Conclusions text says 298.15 K but data are at about 278, 303/308, 333, 338 K (Table 3 pure water also has 303 and 333 K). NaCl block label 0.0291 in Table 3 vs 0.0295 in Tables 4-7 (abstract: 0.0291). Table 6, NaCl 0.0121, 278.17 K second row: P = 0.08557 MPa is much higher than neighbouring pair value 0.06753 (printed so; likely misprint, kept). CO2 in pure water checked by authors against Wilhelm et al. (1977), good agreement. Four of five gases are refrigerants outside the seven-gas list.
